753:t_135:1.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Sorry to disappoint! I'm not $$ミカゲ$$. I'm not throwing my life away over one broken heart!」

753:t_135:2.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「And I don't need to be reincarnated! I'll find a new love through my own efforts!」

753:t_135:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your courage is so endearing.」

753:t_135:4.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Then disappear, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I can't fall in love if the world ends!」

753:t_135:5.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「We don't need a new world! We want a future for this world we love!!」

753:t_136:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ＭＩＸ$$... Knowing love has made you stronger.」

753:t_136:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I know everything. That includes you and $$アンディ$$, of course.」

753:t_136:3.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「You! Do you have any respect for people's privacy!?」

753:t_136:4.en:
$$アンディ$$
「It's fine, $$ＭＩＸ$$! Let's show that self-proclaimed god our love!」

753:t_136:5.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「All right, $$アンディ$$! I need your strength!」

753:t_136:6.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I'll defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ with my own hands, to protect the world where I live with the one I love!!」

753:t_137:1.en:
$$ジン$$
「Let's go, $$ユノハ$$! Let's put an end to all this fighting!」

753:t_137:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You've grown stronger, $$ユノハ$$. Is that the power of love too?」

753:t_137:3.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「Yes! $$ジン$$ gives me courage and strength!」

753:t_137:4.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I'm sure you wouldn't understand, since you don't know what it means to love!」

753:t_137:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am God. God is an all-knowing being.」

753:t_137:6.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「That's a lie! Anyone who knows what it means to love would never stand by and watch the universe perish!」

753:t_137:7.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I'll fight you! Together with $$ジン$$, I'll protect this world where people live and love one another!!」

753:t_138:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$サザンカ$$... You should welcome the new world in my embrace.」

753:t_138:1.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Your smile is so handsome... And so is your voice... I'm getting dizzy...」

753:t_138:2.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「But I absolutely refuse! Someone as sickeningly suave as you isn't my type!」

753:t_138:3.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Everyone's struggling to survive in this world! I don't want some god who's the only one sparkling away!」

753:t_138:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You refuse my salvation for such a reason?」

753:t_138:5.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「You have to trust your inspiration with these things! Handsome or not, you're my enemyyy!!」

753:t_139:0.en:
$$シュレード$$
「I once gave up on this life. I won't hesitate to stake it all on this battle.」

753:t_139:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Stop your futile struggle, $$シュレード$$. You gained this life by transcending causality... Welcome its final moments in peace.」

753:t_139:2.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Sorry, but I don't know how to give up. Even covered in blood, I'll struggle to the very last moment...!」

753:t_139:3.en:
$$シュレード$$
「My life, now play your melody! Con fuoco! Appassionato!」

753:t_139:4.en:
$$シュレード$$
「You must open the way to the future! That is the ultimate melody!!」

753:t_140:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$クレア$$... Could it be that you can see the future?」

753:t_140:1.en:
$$クレア$$
「$$不動$$ told us to fill in the coming pages of the $$ソウセイの書$$ ourselves.」

753:t_140:2.en:
$$クレア$$
「That's why we'll fight! We'll fight for the future we want, instead of obeying the fate handed to us!」

753:t_140:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Will you do so even if despair awaits you?」

753:t_140:5.en:
$$クレア$$
「The first step, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$... is to overcome you!」

753:t_141:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$シンジ$$... Accept me, and you too will be freed from suffering. All your sins will be cleansed.」

753:t_141:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The universe will be reborn. You should be reborn there as a new person too.」

753:t_141:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Giving up because I failed... is just running away...」

753:t_141:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I piloted the EVA, and so much happened... I lost so much, but there's one thing I've learned...」

753:t_141:6.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I mustn't run away...! Nothing will change if I do!」

753:t_141:7.en:
$$カヲル$$
「That's right, $$シンジ$$. That is the truth.」

753:t_141:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And you will learn that despair awaits you there.」

753:t_141:9.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll go anyway...! I want to believe... there's something beyond it!」

753:t_142:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I can fill the emptiness in your soul.」

753:t_142:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Yes... It's the hole you feel in your heart.」

753:t_142:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Accept me, and that hole will be filled. You will become human.」

753:t_142:5.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「...But I have to do that myself...」

753:t_142:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「A doll would reject God?」

753:t_142:7.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「I'm not a doll...」

753:t_143:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$アスカ$$... That left eye of yours too...」

753:t_143:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
「For a man playing God, you don't have a shred of sensitivity!」

753:t_143:2.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I don't care how much power you have! I won't accept help from a man like you who thinks he's the only special one!」

753:t_143:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「If that is your wish, I shall grant it. I will annihilate you here.」

753:t_143:4.en:
$$アスカ$$
「How long do you have to keep talking down to us before you're satisfied!?」

753:t_143:5.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Just you wait! I'll smash that hulk, drag you out and make you apologize!」

753:t_144:0.en:
$$マリ$$
「Every world has some old guy with that smug 'I'm the only one who knows everything' look.」

753:t_144:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Are you referring to that man at $$ＮＥＲＶ$$?」

753:t_144:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「It's such a thrill to smack someone like that with a dose of reality!」

753:t_144:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Can you really do it, $$マリ$$?」

753:t_144:4.en:
$$マリ$$
「That's it! That look is what pisses me off!」

753:t_144:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「That's how it is! I'm getting serious, deadly serious, for this final showdown!」

753:t_145:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ガロード$$... What if I said I would take you and $$ティファ$$ to the new universe...」

753:t_145:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then $$パーラ$$ as well...」

753:t_145:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You're a cheapskate for someone calling himself God! At least say you'll save everyone in the universe!」

753:t_145:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If you can't do that, quit being God!」

753:t_145:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You understand nothing. The universe's collapse is a chance for life itself to start over.」

753:t_145:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What do you mean, a chance!? Who asked for that... Who wanted to die!?」

753:t_145:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I won't accept that! Everyone's overcoming pain and sorrow and living with everything they've got!」

753:t_145:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I need your strength, $$ティファ$$! To protect this world... to protect everyone, I'm going to defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!!」

753:t_146:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You'll watch the universe perish with a smile...!?」

753:t_146:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I can do that because I am prepared to accept all that grief and lamentation.」

753:t_146:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ロラン$$... $$ディアナ・ソレル$$, whom you so admire, is the same. Her role has been to see lives off in just that way.」

753:t_141:4: Kaworu softly addresses Shinji as he sees him reject running away; his utterance is only the name.

753:t_145:3: Advent adds Paula to the unfinished transport offer, which Garrod cuts off again before its verb.
